title: Times, Wars, and Salvations
description: The temporal-redemptive arc that closes the section. T16 names the three structural periods of regeneration — the descent into the contest, the building of the cosmos of the soul, the extracting work down to dissolution. T17 narrates the four wars — the Divine Human's contest with the self's "I am, and there is no other," the operative power's binding of self-loves into the three accommodations, the call's exposure of the self's counterfeit, and Jesus the Radiance's final shining. T18 traces the four salvations by which light is freed in successive stages, each delivering what the previous could not yet receive. With this the seeker has the whole map of seeking — and is now ready to find.
